'''Speaker''' was a [[Yapi]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] and member of the [[Red Claw (tribe)|Red Claw]] tribe living on [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. Speaker was one of the first inhabitants to encounter the crew of the ''[[FarStar]]'' and helped to ally various tribes and [[Species/Legends|species]] to aid them in their fight against [[DarkStryder]].
